generation_e2e_s.scope: CUDA fence before native generate through fence after return; after model load; decode included; Solar native video writing included
generation_e2e_s.aggregation: max rank wall interval per case, sum cases
generation_e2e_s.warmup: ORBIA native extensions prepared before model construction outside E2E. Runtime cold initialization remains included; no subtraction. Exact external CompilationWatch records whether remaining compilation prevents paper latency admission. LongLive observer not recovered.

diffusion_s.scope: Exact native calls to diffusion_start/end, before autoregressive diffusion and before decode; synchronized source marker fences
diffusion_s.aggregation: max rank per case; sum cases; model_only_fps uses counted frames divided by this interval

throughput_fps.denominator: generation_e2e_s including native decode; not historical model_only_fps

fetch_attention_ms.scope: Per attention call CUDA envelope from prepared KV before producer/consumer submission through completion; native grouped routes exclude route construction and measure ready to consumer done
fetch_attention_ms.aggregation: sum calls/layers/steps on each rank; max rank total; sum cases
fetch_attention_ms.status: PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED: exact paper microbenchmark input/denominator cannot be established from E2E records

h2d_transfer_ms.scope: Producer stream begin/end event envelope, may include frontier/slot/rotation waits; not active DMA-only time
h2d_transfer_ms.aggregation: sum observed transfer envelopes per rank; max rank total; do not add to fetch_attention_ms or E2E
h2d_transfer_ms.status: PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED: event envelope is not disjoint DMA activity

h2d_bytes.scope: Actual selected native producer payload byte counters; resident-only path contributes measured zero
h2d_bytes.aggregation: sum per rank; report max rank total with per-rank values retained; not cross-rank total

receive_buffer_mib.scope: Actual receiving/staging tensor capacities, excluding model weights and allocator reserve
receive_buffer_mib.aggregation: maximum observed capacity over calls/cases/ranks; no addition of reused buffers

peak_gpu_memory_gib.scope: L13 paper NVML whole-device sampled peak; others process PyTorch allocator peak; Table1 paper scope unverified
peak_gpu_memory_gib.aggregation: per-rank values retained; peak-of-ranks across cases
peak_gpu_memory_gib.sampling: NVML device UUID, 50ms requested; whole device includes other processes; no guessed device mapping

peak_reserved_memory_gib.scope: torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved since reset immediately before native generate

streaming_overlap.reason: No active kernel/DMA timeline intersection; overlapping event envelopes must not be added.

output_precision: Raw measured floating point seconds/milliseconds and integer bytes; no paper rounding before aggregation
new_run_comparison: Historical values are never injected into measured fields; hardware/source/SP/input and compilation admission must match before numerical comparisons.

build_admission.public_preparation: Load the same public native modules before model construction; no alternate kernel/model warmup
build_admission.raw_e2e: Always retain real successful native wall interval; paper admission is separate and requires all ranks PASS
build_admission.scope: ORBIA profiles; LongLive marks observer unavailable
